metadata.case_name: SIU LEUNG SHANG PETER v. CHUNG WAI MING

plaintiff.occupation_before: Nursing Officer (psychiatric nurse) at Castle Peak Hospital
plaintiff.education_level: Psychiatric Nursing Certificate; post-registration diploma in nursing administration; Certificate of Mental Handicap Nursing; Degree in Nursing (Chinese University in Hong Kong and La Trobe University of Australia)

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to his neck (sprain)
source: I accept the proposition put forward by the defence; namely, Mr Siu suffered a soft tissue injury to his neck, the effects of which were mild and of short duration.
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain, stiffness or tenderness only

injuries.description: degenerative cervical spine / cervical spondylosis with multiple posterior/postero-lateral disc herniations at C3/4, C4/5, C5/6 and C6/7 and calcification of anterior longitudinal ligament (C4-C7)
source: X Ray of the cervical spine revealed calcification of anterior longitudinal ligament. This is a radiological feature suggesting cervical spondylosis (degeneration)
the MRI report noting that there was postero-lateral and posterior herniation at various levels of the C6/7, C5/6, C4/5 and C3/4 discs
calcification in the anterior spinal ligaments between C4 and C7

manifestations.description: dull-aching neck pain, activity related, long-standing
muscle spasms / tightness of paraspinal neck muscles; muscle spasm of the neck muscles
limitation / reduced range of neck movement
damaged self-image and loss of confidence

treatments_received: attended by ambulance to Tuen Mun Hospital (A&E) and given analgesics
treatment by a local bonesetter (Master Tam)
physical therapy (conservative treatment) administered by Dr Kuan since August 2004

losses.description: Prevented his return to the nursing profession (unable to return to his chosen profession)
loss of enjoyment of life; curtailing of activity he had hitherto enjoyed

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: damaged self-image and caused a loss of confidence
